pages.text: While regular fishing, you have a chance to catch a $(l)Bait Box$().$(br)$(br)Inside you will find special baits that can significantly alter your fishing stats.

pages.title: Pros and Cons
pages.text: $(l)Be careful!$() Every bait is unique. Along with strong buffs (like luck or lure speed), baits can also apply debuffs. Always read their descriptions carefully!
